query: INSERT INTO auth_attempt_buckets(key,attempts) VALUES($1,1) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET attempts=CASE WHEN auth_attempt_buckets.window_at < now()-interval '1 minute' THEN 1 ELSE auth_attempt_buckets.attempts+1 END,window_at=CASE WHEN auth_attempt_buckets.window_at < now()-interval '1 minute' THEN now() ELSE auth_attempt_buckets.window_at END,updated_at=now() WHERE auth_attempt_buckets.blocked_until<=now() AND (auth_attempt_buckets.window_at<now()-interval '1 minute' OR auth_attempt_buckets.attempts<$2) RETURNING attempts
